title: Domain WHOIS / RDAP Lookup: Age, Expiry, Registrar
description: Look up domains in the registries' official RDAP service (the modern WHOIS): registration date and age, expiry date and days left, registrar, abuse contact, status codes, nameservers and DNSSEC. Also tells you when a domain is not registered.

domains.title: Domains
domains.description: Domains, URLs or email addresses (subdomains are reduced to the registered domain). Up to 20,000 per run.

domain.title: Domain looked up
domain.description: One domain looked up (a 'not registered' answer counts). Registries without RDAP, invalid input and failed lookups are free.

store.seoTitle: Bulk WHOIS & RDAP Lookup: Domain Age and Expiry
store.seoDescription: Bulk domain lookup from official registry RDAP: creation date, age, expiry, registrar, abuse contact, nameservers, DNSSEC, availability.
